reviews.text: love this serum. post menopause combination skin that is very touchy.. this just calms my skin and soothes it. highly recommend. if i have gone overboard with retinol or cleansing and my skin is feeling a bit tender or flakey this seems ro repair and calm it overnight. will defintely buy again.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款精華。絕經後嘅混合性皮膚，好容易敏感……呢款令我皮膚平靜同舒緩。極力推薦。如果我用 retinol 或者潔面太過，令皮膚有啲脆弱或者起皮，呢款似乎可以喺一晚之內修復同平靜下嚟。一定會再買。

reviews.text: Highly recommend for sensitive, mature skin! I have general redness and this product improved it significantly, leaving my skin much calmer. I also suffer from psoriasis and was happy to find that this is safe to use—it didn't irritate or worsen my condition at all. Definitely repurchasing!"
reviews.zh: 非常推薦俾敏感、成熟皮膚！我有普遍泛紅，呢款產品明顯改善咗，令皮膚平靜好多。我亦患有銀屑病（牛皮癬），好開心發現呢款用起嚟安全——完全冇刺激，亦冇令我嘅情況惡化。一定會再買！"

reviews.text: It helps reduse the redness and inflamation of the pumples,after 2 to 3 days of use once a day the pumples went away. it has a watery and colling texture,not much of a smell. I got combo skin and is great for redness and some pumples control,not much of hydrating for my skin. I would buy it again,it has a good combo of mygwort and centella that is beneficial to the skin.
reviews.zh: 有助減少痘痘嘅泛紅同發炎，每日用一次，用咗 2 至 3 日之後，痘痘就消失咗。質地水潤、清涼，冇乜味道。我係混合皮膚，對泛紅同控制痘痘好有用，但補濕效果唔太多。我會再買，佢將艾草同積雪草配合得幾好，對皮膚有益。

reviews.text: omg i can’t describe how my face felt and how soothing this serum was after being abused by acids. That’s the only time i could tell the difference orherwise if i was using some normal skin care products and my skin was normal i can’t feel or comment but oh man, that was just so good. Highly recommended for sensitized skins!
reviews.zh: 我真係講唔出呢款精華令我張面有幾舒服、幾舒緩，尤其係我被酸嘅產品「虐待」咗之後。只有呢個時候我先感覺到分別；如果用普通護膚品、皮膚正常嘅時候，我感覺唔到，亦評論唔到，但係，嗰次真係好好。對於敏感皮膚，我極力推薦！

reviews.text:
It’s a very lightweight serum, almost feels like a slightly viscous toner, but it’s not runny.
It hydrates and calms the skin and it layers well with other skincare products!
I have combo skin and I used it in the summer, for winter time, maybe try to layer it with another hydrating serum
reviews.zh:
係一款好輕盈嘅精華，幾乎感覺似一款稍為有少少黏稠嘅化妝水，但唔係流質。
補濕、舒緩皮膚，同其他護膚品一齊用都好啱！
我係混合皮膚，夏天用嘅。冬天嗰陣，可能要試吓同另一款補水精華疊搽。

reviews.text: I first tried this serum in a sample and loved it immediately. It’s light, pleasant to apply, and helps reduce oily shine. So I went ahead and bought the full version. Now it’s one of my go-to serums, especially on days when my skin feels oily or a bit stressed.
reviews.zh: 我第一次係試用裝度試過呢款精華，即刻就好鍾意。佢質地輕盈，搽落好舒服，有助減少油光。所以我就買咗正裝。而家佢係我最常用嘅精華之一，尤其係皮膚覺得油或者有少少不穩定嗰啲日子。

reviews.text: Round Lab’s mugwort serum is a true treasure for sensitive and redness-prone skin. Its light, watery texture absorbs quickly, leaving the skin refreshed and calm. Regular use evens out skin tone, reduces irritation, and improves hydration. I like using it at night because in the morning my face looks radiant, healthy, and naturally glowing without any greasy or heavy feeling. I have atopic, combination, and very sensitive skin.
reviews.zh: Round Lab 嘅艾草精華，對於敏感同易泛紅嘅皮膚嚟講，係真正嘅寶物。佢質地輕盈、似水，吸收快，令皮膚清新、平靜。定期使用可以令膚色均勻、減少刺激，亦改善補濕。我鍾意晚上用，因為早上我面睇落光亮、健康，有自然嘅光澤，而且冇油膩或者厚重感。我係特應性（atopic）、混合同非常敏感嘅皮膚。

reviews.text: I was using prescription strength retinoids and my skin was dry and irritated. Initially I went to a store to buy the birch juice moisturizing serum but that was out of stock and I desperately needed something to soothe my skin. So I did a quick check and decided the ingredients list and it seemed a good product. But after using it, I’ve noticed such a big difference. It’s packed with so much goodness that even if you are lazy and don’t have the energy to do a multiple step skincare routine this serum alone calms your skin and hydrates it so much. There is no fragrance, no comedogenic ingredients, noticed no reaction except calm, hydrated skin. So this is my second purchase and I’m loving it.
reviews.zh: 我之前用緊處方強度嘅類維 A（retinoids），皮膚又乾又刺激。起初我去咗一間店，想買 birch juice 保濕精華，但係冇貨，我好需要一啲嘢舒緩皮膚。所以我快手查咗一下，睇咗成分表，覺得似係一款好產品。但係用咗之後，我發現有好大嘅改變。佢含有好多好嘢，就算你懶到冇力做多步驟嘅護膚程序，單係呢款精華都可以舒緩皮膚，補水效果好強。冇香料，冇致粉刺成分，用完冇任何反應，只有舒緩同補水嘅皮膚。所以呢個係我第二次購買，我好鍾意。
